characters.name: Kay Faraday
characters.description1: A self-styled Great Thief and so-called "second Yatagarasu" who's always looking to bag the greatest treasure of all -- the truth.

characters.name: Lotta Hart
characters.description1: A freelance photojournalist who I've met in the past. Known for her ability to sniff out scoops and snap them with her trusty camera.

characters.name: Shi-Long Lang
characters.description1: An Interpol agent with an unrivaled arrest rate. Originally from Zheng Fa.

characters.name: Di-Jun Wang
characters.description1: President of Zheng Fa, and the victim in this case. His body was found on a film set.
characters.description2: The victim in this case. A body double who took the real President Wang's place after he murdered him 12 years ago.

characters.name: Crew Member
characters.description1: A props person at Global Studios, and the first to discover the body. Her name is Penny Nichols.

characters.name: Shaun Fenn
characters.description1: The child star of the monster movie being filmed. Mature for his age with a menacing demeanor.
characters.description2: The child star of the monster movie being filmed. Revealed to be President Wang's son. His mother's name was Amelie Fenn.

characters.name: Verity Gavèlle
characters.description1: A judge, and a member of the Committee for Prosecutorial Excellence. Suspected of being involved in the president's murder.

characters.name: Dick Gumshoe
characters.description1: Homicide detective from the local precinct who's always first on the scene at any murder investigation.

characters.name: Eddie Fender
characters.description1: Senior partner at Edgeworth and Co. Acting as Fifi Laguarde's attorney in place of Rosie Ringer.

characters.name: Franziska von Karma
characters.description1: Daughter of my mentor, Manfred von Karma. She is a highly talented prosecutor, and is currently working with Interpol.

characters.name: Eustace Winner
characters.description1: A rookie prosecutor who thinks he's a real winner. Ran off in shock after discovering that his father is a criminal.

characters.name: Fifi Laguarde
characters.description1: A former prison warden. She is currently on trial for the murder of Bronco Knight.

characters.name: Regina Berry
characters.description1: Head animal trainer at the Berry Big Circus, and Saint's boss.

characters.name: Simeon Saint
characters.description1: An animal-tamer-in-training at the Berry Big Circus. He came to watch the trial.
characters.description2: An animal-tamer-in-training at the Berry Big Circus, who is also the criminal mastermind behind the recent string of incidents.

characters.name: Will Powers
characters.description1: An action star with Global Studios. He's playing the part of Taurusaurus in the movie that's currently being shot.

characters.name: Tabby Lloyd
characters.description1: A journalist who's always on the lookout for a scoop. Protégé of Lotta Hart.

characters.name: Excelsius Winner
characters.description1: Chairman of the Committee for Prosecutorial Excellence and the ringleader behind the underground auction. He is currently under arrest for murder.

characters.name: Bronco Knight
characters.description1: One of President Wang's bodyguards. Murdered while being held at the detention center.
characters.description2: Revealed to be Artie Frost's son. Murdered by Fifi Laguarde while being held at the detention center.

characters.name: Bodhidharma Kanis
characters.description1: A blind ex-assassin who escaped from prison three nights ago. His whereabouts are currently unknown.

characters.name: Shelly de Killer
characters.description1: A professional killer who made an attempt on President Wang's life at Gourd Lake.

characters.name: Alf Aldown
characters.description1: A freelance journalist who was murdered in the incident from 12 years ago.
characters.description2: A freelance journalist who was murdered in the incident from 12 years ago. Rosie Ringer's lover.

characters.name: Rosie Ringer
characters.description1: A member of the Committee for Prosecutorial Excellence. She was killed while attempting to avenge Alf Aldown.

characters.name: Ema Skye
characters.description1: A high school student looking to become a forensic investigator, and the younger sister of my former boss.

evidences.name: Yatagarasu Pin
evidences.description1: The Yatagarasu pin that Kay always wears.
evidences.description2: The Yatagarasu pin that Kay always wears. There was a bug hidden inside.

evidences.name: Forged Letter
evidences.description1: A letter written by an unknown person claiming to be Kay. Touch the Check Button for details.

evidences.name: Bigg Building
evidences.description1: Site of the underground auctions. There is an entrance to the hidden fifty-first floor on the roof.

evidences.name: Creature Feature Flyer
evidences.description1: Latest in the series after a twelve-year hiatus: "Taurusaurus Vs. Gourdy".

evidences.name: Movie Set Locks
evidences.description1: The combination lock on the front gate was left untouched, while the side gate's chain was cut sometime last night.

evidences.name: Crime Scene Notes
evidences.description1: Surrounded by shards of concrete. Flecks of something yellow stuck to clothes. Touch the Check Button for details. [caption] The body lying face-up on top of the dirt, and yet there's no dirt on the front of the body.

evidences.name: Monster Footprints
evidences.description1: The concrete was broken and the earth exposed. But are they really footprints?
evidences.description2: The concrete was broken and the earth exposed. Did Excelsius Winner dig up the ransom money?
evidences.description3: The concrete was broken and the earth exposed after Excelsius Winner dug up President Wang's corpse.

evidences.name: Taurusaurus Head
evidences.description1: Modeled on the first generation Taurusaurus design. Seems like it fell from the roof of the on-set production trailer last night.

evidences.name: Taurusaurus Plushie
evidences.description1: Belonged to President Wang. It can record and play back sound.

evidences.name: Behind-the-Scenes Photo
evidences.description1: Photo taken yesterday. No monster footprints and no body were visible at that point.

evidences.name: Security Camera Footage
evidences.description1: Shows President Wang and Judge Gavèlle in front of the elevator on the roof of the Bigg Building.
evidences.description2: Shows President Wang and Judge Gavèlle arriving on the roof of the Bigg Building. There's no footage of the president riding the elevator down to leave.

evidences.name: Ms. Hart's Statement
evidences.description1: Ms. Hart was in the 51st-floor storeroom the night before last, but didn't see the president pass through.

evidences.name: Shaun's Rehearsal Tape
evidences.description1: Filmed yesterday evening. Shows Shaun rehearsing by a monster footprint.

evidences.name: Blue Truck
evidences.description1: Parked in front of the Bigg Building. Driver is nowhere to be found. The truck was seen driving by Edgeworth today.

evidences.name: Mechanic's Gloves
evidences.description1: Meant for motorcycle maintenance, but currently covered in dirt for some reason.
evidences.description2: Excelsius Winner wore these when digging the monster footprints.

evidences.name: IS-7 Incident Case File
evidences.description1: Details of a murder case from eighteen years ago. Touch the Check Button for details.

evidences.name: Report on Knight
evidences.description1: A report from Warden Laguarde to Chairman Winner about the connection between Knight and Kanis.

evidences.name: Knight's Possessions
evidences.description1: A pocket chess set and a ring. Found in the safe in the auction storeroom.
evidences.description2: A pocket chess set and a ring Knight made from his father's signature stamp.

evidences.name: Bug
evidences.description1: The person in the red raincoat planted this inside Kay's Yatagarasu pin.

evidences.name: Ms. Lloyd's Tape
evidences.description1:
A recording of signals that were intercepted from the bug that was planted in Kay's pin. [info] Saint: Hmm. Perhaps I should let you in on this, Mr. Edgeworth... Actually, I was the one who ordered Blaise Debeste to kill Jill Crane.
Edgeworth: What!?

evidences.name: Bouquet
evidences.description1: A bouquet of lion lilies given to President Wang by Judge Gavèlle. Recovered from on top of his body by Shaun.

evidences.name: Sedative
evidences.description1: Used on both Kay and Shaun during their kidnapping. Brand name is "3 Zs".

evidences.name: SS-5 Incident Case File
evidences.description1: 12-year-old incident in which President Wang was kidnapped and the sole witness was murdered. Touch the Check Button for details.

evidences.name: Fire
evidences.description1: One of the children set the orphanage yard on fire as a prank sometime during the evening before the incident.

evidences.name: Mr. Aldown's Autopsy Report
evidences.description1: Victim was struck on the head and died at around 1 AM on February 10th.

evidences.name: Mr. Aldown's Final Call
evidences.description1: Message left on Rosie Ringer's phone detailing what Aldown saw.

evidences.name: Bloody Button
evidences.description1: Found clutched in Aldown's right hand. The blood is his.

evidences.name: Mr. Aldown's Photograph
evidences.description1: Shows the president being kidnapped. Only one picture was taken. Touch the Check Button for details.
evidences.description2: Staged photograph taken after Aldown was killed. Touch the Check Button for details.

evidences.name: Victim's Shoes
evidences.description1: Not actually Aldown's shoes. They appear to have been placed on his feet by the culprit after the murder took place.

evidences.name: Mysterious Blood Stain
evidences.description1: Left on the scene of the murder 12 years ago. The blood wasn't Aldown's.

evidences.name: Child's Drawing
evidences.description1: A picture drawn by the child who caused the fire during the incident 12 years ago. It depicts what he saw the night of the incident.

evidences.name: Correspondence Chess Diagram
evidences.description1: Sent to Bronco Knight by Bodhidharma Kanis. Printed rather than hand-written.
evidences.description2: Letter from Kanis retyped by the mastermind, and then sent on to Bronco Knight.

evidences.name: Lion Hot Air Balloon
evidences.description1: Smaller balloon used for promotional purposes. Saint is in charge of it and drives it around on the back of a truck.

testimonies.testimony: When the president was pushed off the roof, Shaun was waiting at the film lot.
If Shaun was an accomplice, the problem with the locks would be resolved.
The two of them then hid the president's body.
Inside that monster costume over there...
There's dirt inside the costume. It must have gotten there when the body was hidden inside.

source.evidence_span: The body lying face-up on top of the dirt, and yet there's no dirt on the front of the body.
source.testimony_span: There's dirt inside the costume. It must have gotten there when the body was hidden inside.

turns.summarizedContext: Agent Lang explains how Gravelle and Shaun could have been accomplices.
reasoning: Fact 1: The witness claims dirt got inside the costume when the body was hidden inside.
Fact 2: The evidence suggests there is no dirt on the front of the body.
Prop 1: If dirt got inside a container that contains an object, the object must be dirty.

testimonies.testimony: It happened when I was riding the balloon to the rooftop.
I saw the body double and you, Ms. Gravelle, on the roof. Talk about a surprise.
Only the double noticed me. He told Ms. Gravelle to leave ahead of him.
He then pointed a gun at me and fired.
After the double fired one shot, he entered the hatch to the 51st floor.

source.evidence_span: Ms. Hart was in the 51st-floor storeroom the night before last, but didn't see the president pass through.
source.testimony_span: he entered the hatch to the 51st floor

turns.summarizedContext: The witness Simeon is describing the events of two nights ago.
reasoning: Fact 1: The witness claims the president's double went to the 51st floor.
Fact 2: The evidence suggests Hart was in the 51st-floor storeroom the night before last, but didn't see the president pass through.
Prop 1: If a person A goes to a location where person B is at, person B would have seen person A pass through.
